title: Agentic-vision event envelope
description: Locked contract for every Redis pub/sub message published by the agentic stack. Owned by AE-509 / P0 — Agentic Foundation.

topic.description: Routing key; must match one of src/events/topics.Topic values.

event_id.description: Idempotency key — UUID v4 minted at publish time.

scope.description: Which entity this event is about.

scope_id.description: Identifier for the scoped entity; null when scope='global'.

payload.description: Topic-specific data. Each producer defines its own shape; readers must tolerate unknown fields.

confidence.description: Producer's self-reported confidence in the payload (0–1).

source_service.description: Service name that published the event (e.g. the-brain, preventor).
